5dd6951dad1bb3718d4ce62ca9ce324bee4d6fb5: A resort on a human scale, Bormio relies on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 50 km of runs are ideal for a 3- to 4-day stay, especially with family or for skiers who don't need to constantly change their playground. Bormio's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-kept green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. On snow reliability, Bormio is in a strong position with its summit at 3017 m: even in capricious winters, the upper runs hold up well until April. The village at 1200 m is also well placed to offer comfortable conditions from mid-December. The budget for a stay in Bormio is clearly high: 60€ for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants among the most expensive in the Alps. It's the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you go. In short: Bormio keeps its promises. A Northern Alps resort that will suit most profiles without disappointing.
